ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-20-2013 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288.
Clifford Y. Wang, Esq., appearing for Petitioners. Jian Hua Yu and Wenqiong Hu father and mother of minors present in court.
Petitioners Sworn and examined through Cantonese Interpreter attorney Clifford Y. Wang.
Proof of Publication on file.
No objections to the proposed change of names were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Wanyan Hu to Angela WanYan Yu.
Petition for name change for mother WenQion Hu is withdrawn without prejudice. The OSC re: Name change for mother is ordered off calendar and dissolved.
Decree Changing Name for minor signed in open court.
